arxiv-1903-02968.title: Intrinsic Lipschitz graphs in Carnot groups of step 2 Thanks: D.D.D. is supported by University of Trento, Italy.
arxiv-1903-02968.creator: Daniela Di Donato
arxiv-1903-02968.description: Abstract . We focus our attention on the notion of intrinsic Lipschitz graphs, inside a special class of metric spaces i.e. the Carnot groups. More precisely, we provide a characterization of locally intrinsic Lipschitz functions in Carnot groups of step 2 2 in terms of their intrinsic distributional gradients. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 35R03; Secondary 28A75, 53C17 1.

arxiv-2211-02941.title: Small Language Models for Tabular Data
arxiv-2211-02941.creator: Benjamin L. Badger
arxiv-2211-02941.description: Abstract Supervised deep learning is most commonly applied to difficult problems defined on large and often extensively curated datasets. Here we demonstrate the ability of deep representation learning to address problems of classification and regression from small and poorly formed tabular datasets by encoding input information as abstracted sequences composed of a fixed number of characters per input field.

arxiv-2302-00810.title: Beyond KNN: Deep Neighborhood Learning for WiFi-based Indoor Positioning Systems
arxiv-2302-00810.creator: 1 st Yinhuan Dong, 2 nd Francisco Zampella, 3 rd Firas Alsehly
arxiv-2302-00810.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by 1 st Yinhuan Dong, 2 nd Francisco Zampella, 3 rd Firas Alsehly. K-Neares Neighbors (KNN) and its variant weighted KNN (WKNN) have been explored for years in both academy and industry to provide stable and reliable performance in WiFi-based indoor positioning systems. Such algorithms estimate the location of a given point based on the locality information from the selected nearest WiFi neighbors according to some distance metrics calculated from the combination of WiFi received signal strength (RSS).

arxiv-2303-00842.title: Discrete approximation of nonlocal-gradient energies
arxiv-2303-00842.creator: Andrea Braides
arxiv-2303-00842.description: Abstract We study a discrete approximation of functionals depending on nonlocal gradients. The discretized functionals are proved to be coercive in classical Sobolev spaces. arxiv-2307-14186.title: Complexity results for the Pilot Assignment problem in Cell-Free Massive MIMO
arxiv-2307-14186.creator: Shruthi Prusty (✉), Sofiat Olaosebikan
arxiv-2307-14186.description: Abstract Wireless communication is enabling billions of people to connect to each other and the internet, transforming every sector of the economy, and building the foundations for powerful new technologies that hold great promise to improve lives at an unprecedented rate and scale.

arxiv-2403-16239.title: Thermal Analysis for NVIDIA GTX480 Fermi GPU Architecture
arxiv-2403-16239.creator: Savinay Nagendra
arxiv-2403-16239.description: Abstract In this project, we design a four-layer (Silicon—TIM—Silicon—TIM), 3D floor plan for NVIDIA GTX480 Fermi GPU architecture and compare heat dissipation and power trends for matrix multiplication and Needleman-Wunsch kernels. First, cuda kernels for the two algorithms are written. These kernels are compiled and executed with the GPGPU Simulator to extract power logs for varying tensor sizes.

arxiv-2406-04219.title: Multi-Agent Imitation Learning: Value is Easy, Regret is Hard
arxiv-2406-04219.creator: Jingwu Tang, Gokul Swamy, Fei Fang, Zhiwei Steven Wu
arxiv-2406-04219.description: Abstract We study a multi-agent imitation learning (MAIL) problem where we take the perspective of a learner attempting to coordinate a group of agents based on demonstrations of an expert doing so. Most prior work in MAIL essentially reduces the problem to matching the behavior of the expert within the support of the demonstrations.

arxiv-2407-18659.title: The Great Wave
arxiv-2407-18659.creator: E. Poggio, S. Khanna, R. Drimmel, E. Zari, E. D’Onghia, M. G. Lattanzi, P. A. Palicio, A. Recio-Blanco, L. Thulasidharan
arxiv-2407-18659.description: Abstract We analyse the three-dimensional structure and kinematics of two samples of young stars in the Galactic disc, containing respectively young giants ( ∼ \sim 17 000 stars out to heliocentric distances of ∼ \sim 7 kpc) and classical Cepheids ( ∼ \sim 3400 stars out to heliocentric distances of ∼ \sim 15 kpc).

arxiv-2503-15688.title: Capturing a Moving Target by Two Robots in the F2F Model
arxiv-2503-15688.creator: Khaled Jawhar, Evangelos Kranakis
arxiv-2503-15688.description: Abstract . We study a search problem on capturing a moving target on an infinite real line. Two autonomous mobile robots (which can move with a maximum speed of 1) are initially placed at the origin, while an oblivious moving target is initially placed at a distance d d away from the origin.

arxiv-2506-01882.title: Learning thermodynamic master equations for open quantum systems
arxiv-2506-01882.creator: Peter Sentz, Stanley Nicholson, Yujin Cho, Sohail Reddy, Brendan Keith, Stefanie Günther
arxiv-2506-01882.description: Abstract The characterization of Hamiltonians and other components of open quantum dynamical systems plays a crucial role in quantum computing and other applications. Scientific machine learning techniques have been applied to this problem in a variety of ways, including by modeling with deep neural networks.

arxiv-2507-16032.title: Schrödinger cat state formation in small bosonic Josephson junctions at finite temperatures and dissipation
arxiv-2507-16032.creator: D.V.Tsarev, D.V. Ansimov, S.A. Podoshvedov, A.P. Alodjants
arxiv-2507-16032.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by D.V.Tsarev, D.V. Ansimov, S.A. Podoshvedov, A.P. Alodjants. In this work, we consider the feasibility of Schrödinger cat (SC) and N ​ 00 ​ N N00N states formation by a convenient bosonic Josephson junction (BJJ) system in two-mode approximation. Starting with purely quantum description of two-mode Bose-Einstein condensate we investigate the effective potential approach that provides an accurate analytical description for the system with a large number of particles.

arxiv-2508-19254.title: Real-Time Intuitive AI Drawing System for Collaboration: Enhancing Human Creativity through Formal and Contextual Intent Integration
arxiv-2508-19254.creator: Jookyung Song chsjk9005@gmail.com, MooKyoung Kang nostone@gmail.com, Nojun Kwak nojunk@snu.ac.kr
arxiv-2508-19254.description: Abstract This paper presents a real-time generative drawing system that interprets and integrates both formal intent —the structural, compositional, and stylistic attributes of a sketch—and contextual intent —the semantic and thematic meaning inferred from its visual content - into a unified transformation process.

arxiv-2510-15477.title: The effect of near-surface winds on surface temperature and dust transport on Venus
arxiv-2510-15477.creator: Maxence Lefèvre, Sébastien Lebonnois, Aymeric Spiga, François Forget
arxiv-2510-15477.description: Abstract The knowledge of the Venus near-surface atmosphere is sparse. Few spacecrafts landed on the surface and measured winds with amplitudes below 1 m/s. The diurnal cycle of the wind amplitude and orientation is not known. Recent numerical simulations showed that slope winds along topographic structures could strongly impact the direction of winds.

arxiv-2511-08517.title: Nuclear spin relaxation in zero- to ultralow-field magnetic resonance spectroscopy
arxiv-2511-08517.creator: Florin Teleanu, Anne M. Fabricant, Chengtong Zhang, Gary P. Centers, Dmitry Budker, Danila A. Barskiy, Alexej Jerschow
arxiv-2511-08517.description: Abstract Nuclear-magnetic-resonance experiments can interrogate a broad spectrum of molecular-tumbling regimes and can accurately measure interatomic distances in solution with sub-nanometer resolution. In the zero- to ultralow-field (ZULF) regime, population and coherence decay reveal nontrivial behavior due to strong coupling between nuclear spins.

arxiv-2604-18742.title: JASPER: Joint Bayesian Analysis of Spatial Expression via Regression
arxiv-2604-18742.creator: Pritam Dey, Rajarshi Guhaniyogi, Yang Ni, Bani K. Mallick

gao-gaoreports-gao-06-170t.description: Reserve Forces: Army National Guard's Role, Organization, and Equipment Need to be Reexamined (2005).

pmc-10744616.title: Association of Gestational Hypertension with Sociodemographic and Anthropometric Factors, Perinatal Outcomes, Breastfeeding Practices, and Mediterranean Diet Adherence: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-10744616.creator: Eleni Pavlidou, Sousana K. Papadopoulou, Olga Alexatou, Gerasimos Tsourouflis, Georgios Antasouras, Aikaterini Louka, Ioanna P. Chatziprodromidou, Maria Mentzelou, Anastasia Sampani, Maria Chrysafi, Thomas Apostolou, Antonios Dakanalis, Vasiliki G. Papadopoulou, Constantinos Giaginis
pmc-10744616.description: Background and Objectives: Gestational hypertension has been associated with several pregnancy short-term and long-term complications, affecting both the mother and her infant’s health. The present study aims to assess the potential association of gestational hypertension with sociodemographic and anthropometry factors, perinatal outcomes, breastfeeding habits, and Mediterranean diet (MD) compliance.

pmc-11287466.title: Herbal Medicine-Derived Exosome-Like Nanovesicles: A Rising Star in Cancer Therapy
pmc-11287466.creator: Kaifei Chu, Jie Liu, Xu Zhang, Minran Wang, Wanping Yu, Yuyue Chen, Lingling Xu, Geng Yang, Naru Zhang, Tiejun Zhao
pmc-11287466.description: Plant-derived exosome-like nanovesicles (PDNVs) are small nanoscale vesicles containing lipids, RNAs, proteins and some plant natural products secreted by plant cells. Over the last decade, PDNVs have garnered significant interest due to its exceptional therapeutic benefits in the treatment of various diseases. Herbal medicine, as a medicinal plant, plays an important role in the treatment of diseases including cancer.

pmc-12598950.title: Efficacy of acupuncture for pregnancy with early-onset ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome: study protocol for a randomised controlled clinical trial
pmc-12598950.creator: Kaoling Wen, Dejuan Sun, Dongying Wang, Yu Li, Jue Wang, Bo Wang, Meiqi Zhan, Hongyu Tan, Ting Su, Liming Lu, Xiaoyan Liang, Jinglin Lin, Chunzhi Tang, Xin Lai
pmc-12598950.description: IntroductionAlthough ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) is a common complication primarily seen in patients undergoing in vitro fertilisation-embryo transfer, there is no recognised effective treatment to manage it, especially for pregnant patients. As an alternative non-pharmacological treatment, acupuncture presents itself as a promising, safe and effective intervention for those suffering from OHSS.

pmc-12734323.title: Effects of a Scapular-Focused Exercise Protocol for Patients with Rotator Cuff-Related Pain Syndrome—A Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-12734323.creator: Cristina dos Santos, Isabel Bastos de Almeida, Mark A. Jones, Ricardo Matias
pmc-12734323.description: Background: Current clinical practice still lacks consistent evidence in the physiotherapy management of rotator cuff-related pain syndrome (RCS). The purpose of this trial was to compare the effectiveness of a scapular-focused treatment with and without real-time electromyographic biofeedback (EMGBF) to a control therapy in patients with RCS, in the short-term.

pmc-12745042.title: Kinetics of hematologic response in AL amyloidosis: Insights from clinical and cytogenetic subgroup analysis in the daratumumab era
pmc-12745042.creator: Abdul‐Hamid Bazarbachi, Saurabh Zanwar, Ute Hegenbart, Despina Trajanova, Divaya Bhutani, Morie A Gertz, Angela Dispenzieri, Shaji Kumar, Anita D'Souza, Anannya Patwari, Andrew Cowan, GuiZhen Chen, Paolo Milani, Giovanni Palladini, Vaishali Sanchorawala, Geethika Bodanapu, Mohamad Mohty, Suzanne Len
pmc-12745042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Rapid and profound reduction of free light chains (FLCs) improves outcomes in AL amyloidosis; however, early FLC kinetics with daratumumab‐based frontline therapy remain undefined. We retrospectively analyzed 315 patients treated with daratumumab–bortezomib–cyclophosphamide–dexamethasone (Dara–VCd) or Dara–Vd at eight centers.

pmc-13026180.title: Incidence of Acute Myocardial Infarction in Hungary: A Nationwide Study
pmc-13026180.creator: Klára Rácz, Gábor Tóth, Elek Dinya, János Németh
pmc-13026180.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objective: Acute myocardial infarction (AMI) is a common, life-threatening condition and represents a substantial disease burden in Hungary. The aim of this study was to estimate the incidence of AMI in Hungary. Methods: This nationwide, retrospective, longitudinal study used data from the National Health Insurance Fund and included patients aged ≥15 years who were newly diagnosed with AMI (ICD-10 codes I21 or I22) between 1 January 2019 and 31 December 2023.

pmc-13079193.title: The exquisite link between potassium homeostasis regulation and cardiovascular health: exploration and analysis
pmc-13079193.creator: Ci Wang, Xiangyuan Huang, Zeyu Zhang, Dongming Lin, Shuwei Huang
pmc-13079193.description: Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) are the leading global cause of mortality, with potassium homeostasis playing a fundamental role in their pathophysiology. Tightly regulated potassium ions (K+) are essential for cardiac electrophysiological stability, and their dysregulation is a critical driver of disorders, particularly cardiac arrhythmias.

pmc-13134089.title: Coexistence of pulmonary aspergillosis and cryptococcosis following treatment for SARS-CoV-2 infection in a kidney transplant recipient: a rare case report and literature review
pmc-13134089.creator: Cuirong Hu, Liang Ying, Yaping Zhan, Jinkun Wang, Jinling Ye, Jifang Lu, Haijiao Jin, Xiaoming Tan, Leyi Gu, Yulong Yao, Na Jiang
pmc-13134089.description: BackgroundSevere acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2)- associated pneumonia increases patients’ susceptibility to fungal superinfections, particularly among immunocompromised individuals.Case presentationA 60-year-old woman with history of kidney transplantation was admitted for recurrent fever and positive SARS-CoV-2 antigen on pharyngeal swab testing. The patient developed rapid-onset respiratory distress secondary to progressive pulmonary infection and received assisted mechanical ventilation.

pmc-13141416.title: Acupuncture vs. sham acupuncture for cancer-related fatigue in patients with breast cancer: a double-center, randomized, single-blind pilot study
pmc-13141416.creator: Yu Huang, Jianying Chang, Xianming Wu, Guishuang He, Qin Guo, Caihong Lan, Shuo Yang, Qian Mo
pmc-13141416.description: ObjectiveCancer-related fatigue is highly prevalent among cancer patients. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of acupuncture on fatigue levels and quality of life in breast cancer patients with cancer-related fatigue.MethodsThis pilot study employed a double-center, randomized, single-blind, placebo-controlled design.

pmc-13340152.title: Synergistic effects of crop straw formulations on Stropharia rugosoannulata cultivation and soil microecology in continuous cropping systems
pmc-13340152.creator: Mengjiao Ding, Nianjie Shang, Lukuo Zhou, Hao Shu, Dengxiang Liu, Taibo Liang, Yunfei Ma, Weichang Gao, Yanling Zhang
pmc-13340152.description: Biological amendment strategies effectively enhance the physical and chemical properties of continuously cropped soils, offering an environmentally sustainable and economically viable solution. This study investigated the impacts of distinct straw formulations on the cultivation performance of Stropharia rugosoannulata and associated soil microbial communities.

pmc-13370313.title: Effect of Peroneal Electrical Stimulation and Ankle-Foot Orthosis on Gait Parameters and Ground Clearance Among Stroke Survivors
pmc-13370313.creator: Janhavi Kulkarni, Suraj Kanase
